summary: Verified Story chooser 'Live Story' gate (hidden on web, kept for native), /live Content Streaming panel still rendered for streamer, backend /api/stream/settings PUT/GET with validation + defaults, unit tests on streaming._maybe_auto_start / _sweep_auto_live / /api/stream/end hold behavior (monkeypatched, no real LiveKit), and Playwright-intercepted OBS panel UI showing signal light + auto-live toggle + waiting-hint and switching to go-live button on uncheck + 'Waiting for OBS' on idle.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/streaming.py _sweep_auto_live uses filter {'user_id': uid, 'hold': True} with $set to clear hold; update does nothing if hold was never set. Current code works because hold defaults to false in output, but add $set with upsert False explicitly if a doc without hold needs no change — minor nit, no action required.
pytest-asyncio was not installed; added shared asyncio loop pattern (run()) in test file to avoid 'Event loop is closed' due to motor binding to one loop.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — tests create+delete stream_ingress/stream_settings/live_streams for the owner and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_obs_webflow.py. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest backend/tests/test_obs_webflow.py -n 0. Avoid -n 2 default (xdist can race on shared motor loop) OR run module isolated. Use dotenv.load for /app/backend/.env before importing server. Playwright: route-intercept GET /api/stream/ingress + PUT /api/stream/settings and visit /live for OBS panel.
rca of the issue: No bug. Task was a verification of (1) native-only gating of story-chooser-live in src/components/Stories.tsx (via Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) and (2) OBS auto-live web flow in backend/streaming.py + ObsStudioPanel.tsx. All assertions passed.
